title: Learning Agile Intruder Interception using Differentiable Quadrotor Dynamics
authors: Michael Anoruo, Xiaoyu Tian, Abhishek Rathod, Timothy Naudet, Thomas Canchola, Eric Sturzinger, Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib
summary: Learns a control policy that intercepts an intruder using only the 3D unit direction vector to the intruder and the interceptor state. An analytical policy gradient over differentiable quadrotor dynamics achieves agile interception up to 10 m/s, outperforming point-mass baselines by ~30%.
journal_ref: arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.02472

title: AcroRL: Learning Aggressive Quadrotor Inversion using Bidirectional Thrust
authors: Gabriel Rodriguez, Henri Sayag, Abhishek Rathod, John Stecklein, Siddharth Saha, Christopher Barngrover, Wennie Tabib
summary: Reinforcement learning policies modulate a constant reference trajectory so a bidirectional-thrust quadrotor performs compact, position-constrained inversions, remaining compatible with standard trajectory generation. Reduces position RMSE by 32% and settling time by 57% versus the strongest optimization-based baseline, with hardware RMSE below 0.35 m.
journal_ref: arXiv preprint arXiv:2605.24301

title: Quadrotor Navigation using Reinforcement Learning with Privileged Information
authors: Jonathan Lee, Abhishek Rathod, Kshitij Goel, John Stecklein, Wennie Tabib
summary: Uses time-of-arrival (ToA) maps as privileged information and a yaw alignment loss so that a learned policy routes around large obstacles, walls and dead-ends where prior learning-based methods fail. 86% success rate in photo-realistic simulation (34% over baselines), and 20 outdoor flights covering 589 m at up to 4 m/s day and night.
journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026

title: Zero-Shot Metric Depth Estimation via Monocular Visual-Inertial Rescaling for Autonomous Aerial Navigation
authors: Steven Yang, Xiaoyu Tian, Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib
summary: Proposes lightweight zero-shot rescaling strategies that turn relative monocular depth into metric depth using the sparse 3D feature map of a visual-inertial navigation system, avoiding heavy sensors or domain-specific fine-tuning. Monotonic spline fitting performs best and runs onboard a compute-constrained quadrotor at 15 Hz for collision avoidance.
journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026

title: Distance and Collision Probability Estimation from Gaussian Surface Models
authors: Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib
summary: Estimates Euclidean distance, gradient and collision probability between an ellipsoidal robot and an environment modeled as Gaussian surfaces, extending ellipsoid-to-ellipsoid formulations to GMM surfaces with a geometric blending step. Runs within microseconds per ellipsoid pair on embedded CPUs, enabling uncertainty-aware planning in clutter.
journal_ref: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2025

title: Decentralized Uncertainty-Aware Active Search with a Team of Aerial Robots
authors: Wennie Tabib, John Stecklein, Caleb McDowell, Kshitij Goel, Felix Jonathan, Abhishek Rathod, Meghan Kokoski, Edsel Burkholder, Brian Wallace, Luis Ernesto Navarro-Serment, Nikhil Angad Bakshi, Tejus Gupta, Norman Papernick, David Guttendorf, Erik E. Kahn, Jessica Kasemer, Jesse Holdaway, Jeff Schneider
summary: Demonstrates a decentralized active search system that biases trajectories toward additional views of uncertain objects of interest, using stochasticity for coverage when communications are denied and sharing poses, goals and detections when they are available. Finds all a-priori unknown objects with ~3 m mean error at 50-60 m altitude in Bloomingdale, OH field experiments.
journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on Experimental Robotics (ISER) 2025

title: Rapid Quadrotor Navigation in Diverse Environments using an Onboard Depth Camera
authors: Jonathan Lee, Abhishek Rathod, Kshitij Goel, John Stecklein, Wennie Tabib
summary: Develops a reactive planner over forward-arc motion primitives that exploits a history of RGB-D observations to fly safely close to obstacles, scheduling a safe stopping action every planning round. Thousands of simulations plus deployments in caves and forests yield a 24% success-rate gain over state of the art.
journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR) 2024 - Best Paper Award

title: Incremental Multimodal Surface Mapping via Self-Organizing Gaussian Mixture Models
authors: Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib
summary: Represents the environment as a continuous probabilistic model that reconstructs geometry and intensity at high resolution while compressing the point cloud. A spatial hash map for rapid GMM submap extraction plus relevance/redundancy detection gives an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art incremental GMM mapping with a better accuracy-size tradeoff.
journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2023

title: GIRA: Gaussian Mixture Models for Inference and Robot Autonomy
authors: Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib
summary: Presents the open-source GIRA framework, unifying reconstruction, pose estimation and occupancy modeling with Gaussian mixture models, and contributes GPU-accelerated GMM learning that is 10-100x faster than prior CPU implementations.
journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2023

title: Probabilistic Point Cloud Modeling via Self-Organizing Gaussian Mixture Models
authors: Kshitij Goel, Nathan Michael, Wennie Tabib
summary: Adapts the number of GMM components to scene complexity using a self-organizing principle from information-theoretic learning, removing per-use-case tuning while balancing model fidelity and size across real-world point clouds.
journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2023

title: Hierarchical Collision Avoidance for Adaptive-Speed Multirotor Teleoperation
authors: Kshitij Goel, Yves Georgy Daoud, Nathan Michael, Wennie Tabib
summary: Improves safe motion-primitive teleoperation with a hierarchical collision checker that jointly adapts local map voxel size and maximum vehicle speed at 10 Hz, so operators no longer set speeds by hand and the vehicle can still enter tight spaces. Validated in simulation and real-world flights.
journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR) 2022 - Best Paper Award

title: Collaborative Human-Robot Exploration via Implicit Coordination
authors: Yves Georgy Daoud, Kshitij Goel, Nathan Michael, Wennie Tabib
summary: Implicitly communicates a region of interest from a helmet-mounted depth camera on the human to the robot, then biases an information-gain exploration objective inside the human-provided viewpoint. The aerial system safely reaches regions the human cannot see or enter; validated in simulation and a motion-capture arena.
journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR) 2022

title: Autonomous Cave Surveying with an Aerial Robot
authors: Wennie Tabib, Kshitij Goel, John Yao, Curtis Boirum, Nathan Michael
summary: Surveys caves in total darkness with a depth camera for mapping, a downward-facing camera for state estimation and forward/downward lights. Observations are compressed into Gaussian mixture models while a local occupancy grid feeds a planner that greedily maximizes an information-theoretic objective; deployed in Laurel Caverns and a wild West Virginia cave.
journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO) 2021 - King-Sun Fu Memorial Best Paper Award Honorable Mention

title: Rapid and High-Fidelity Subsurface Exploration with Multiple Aerial Robots
authors: Kshitij Goel, Wennie Tabib, Nathan Michael
summary: Develops communication-efficient distributed perceptual modeling for rapid multi-robot cave exploration, keeping high-fidelity maps compatible with low-bandwidth links. Shows significant exploration-rate gains over state of the art in simulation and in a wild West Virginia cave.
journal_ref: International Symposium on Experimental Robotics (ISER) 2021

title: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping of Subterranean Voids with Gaussian Mixture Models
authors: Wennie Tabib, Nathan Michael
summary: Performs SLAM of subterranean voids with maps represented as Gaussian mixture models, giving a compact probabilistic representation suited to low-bandwidth communication in cave and tunnel exploration.
journal_ref: Conference on Field and Service Robotics (FSR) 2019

title: Real-time Information-Theoretic Exploration with Gaussian Mixture Model Maps
authors: Wennie Tabib, Kshitij Goel, John Yao, Curtis Boirum, Nathan Michael
summary: Plans next-best views in real time directly over GMM maps, so information-theoretic exploration operates on a compact continuous representation instead of a dense occupancy grid.
journal_ref: Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2019

title: Variable Resolution Occupancy Mapping using Gaussian Mixture Models
authors: Cormac O'Meadhra, Wennie Tabib, Nathan Michael
summary: Derives occupancy at varying resolution by sampling from a GMM distribution and ray-tracing to the camera position, avoiding storage of dense multi-resolution occupancy grids while preserving fine structure.
journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2019

title: On-Manifold GMM Registration
authors: Wennie Tabib, Cormac O'Meadhra, Nathan Michael
summary: Estimates position and orientation from successive depth or LiDAR observations by treating sensor observations as approximate continuous belief distributions, with an on-manifold GMM registration formulation that outperforms prior art.
journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2018

title: Computationally Efficient Information-Theoretic Exploration of Pits and Caves
authors: Wennie Tabib, Micah Corah, Nathan Michael, Red Whittaker
summary: Formulates information-theoretic exploration of pits and caves with computationally efficient approximations, targeting subsurface voids where lighting, geometry and sensing are severely constrained.
journal_ref: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2016

title: Efficient Multi-Sensor Exploration Using Dependent Observations and Conditional Mutual Information
authors: Wennie Tabib, Red Whittaker, Nathan Michael
summary: Exploits conditionally dependent sensor observations through conditional mutual information to plan multi-modal exploration, avoiding double-counting of correlated information from heterogeneous sensors.
journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR) 2016

title: Planning Views to Model Planetary Pits Under Transient Illumination
authors: Heather Jones, Wennie Tabib, William L. Red Whittaker
summary: Plans camera views for modeling planetary pits while illumination varies transiently, a precursor to RISLab's later subsurface exploration and cave surveying work.
journal_ref: IEEE Aerospace Conference 2015
